home.about: Home as a first-time visitor sees it (app.localhost: the real buttons, not the localhost test panel).

home-levels.about: Home scrolled to the four level cards: their badges and buttons in the level colours (#393).

register.about: The sign-up dialog an invite link opens, with the password rule under the password (#388).

forgot.about: The forgot-password view of the sign-in dialog, with its 44 px back link (#391).

reset.about: The new-password view a reset link opens, with its Mégse (Cancel) button (#391).

guest-merge.about: The returning guest signs in and is asked whether to add the guest progress, with the back link (#363, #391).

dashboard.about: The learning path of a signed-in learner.

lesson.about: The current node's sheet with Kezdés (Start), a lesson item with an answer picked and ELLENŐRZÉS (Check) lit, then the feedback banner with TOVÁBB (Continue).

lesson-wrong.about: A one-item mistakes lesson answered wrongly: the danger banner and its TOVÁBB (#393).

postlesson.about: The same lesson answered rightly, then the result screen: XP, accuracy and TOVÁBB (#393).

leaderboard.about: The league table of a signed-in learner.

profile.about: The profile of a signed-in learner.

practice.about: The practice hub of a signed-in learner.

connection.about: get_session answers 500: the 'can't reach the server' screen with its retry button (#383).

save-error.about: save_progress answers 500 after a lesson starts: the save-failed notice over the lesson (#383).

shop.about: The shop dialog of a signed-in learner with 2 streak shields, opened from the tab bar.

level-picker.about: The level picker of a signed-in learner, opened from the levels tab's drawer; the first screen on the Dialog primitive (#396).

quit-sheet.about: A lesson's quit sheet, opened with ✖: 'Biztosan kilépsz?' with Folytatom and Kilépek, the first ConfirmSheet (#397).

grammar.about: The first module's grammar guide opened from its banner, with the banner title above it (#395).

reward.about: The weekly league reward popup and its 'Gratulálunk!' heading, which was purple gradient text (#395).

friends.about: Friends of a signed-in learner: the section headings and the send-request button (#395).

legal.about: The privacy policy: the legal card's title and section headings, which were gradient text (#395).

notfound.about: The 404 page and its heading, which was gradient text (#395).

feedback-widget.about: The floating feedback button's panel on the path of a signed-in learner (#391).

contact.about: Contact: the e-mail and copy buttons at the top, then the form after an empty send and after a send that opens the mail app (#392).

tokens.about: Every pair in token-pairs.json as the system's theme resolves it: the accent ramp as text (4.5:1) and non-text (3:1), labels on fills, the state, game, module and level colours (#393).

tokens-forced.about: The same pairs with the theme picked by hand against the system: data-theme=dark under a light system, data-theme=light under a dark one (#393).
